title: Ziyarat of Imam Husain(as) on the Day of Arafah

lines.english: Allah is the Most Great of all.
All praise be to Allah very much.

lines.transliteration: wa subhana allahi bukratan wa asilan
lines.english: Glory be to Allah in mornings and evenings.
All praise be to Allah Who has guided us to this.

lines.arabic: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلاَ أَنْ هَدَانَا ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: wa ma kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana allahu
lines.english: We would not have been guided if Allah had not guided us.
The messengers of our Lord have indeed come with the truth.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah, peace of Allah be upon him and his Household.
Peace be upon the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala fatimata alzzahra'i sayyidati nisa'i al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be upon Fatimah the luminous and the doyenne of all women of the world.
Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
Peace be upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn.
Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon Musa the son of Ja`far.
Peace be upon `Ali the son of Musa.
Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon `Ali the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon the virtuous Successor and Awaited.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.
I—the servant of you and the son of your servant and your bondwoman,
who is loyal to those who are loyal to you
and enemy of those who are your enemies—
am seeking the shelter of your shrine
and seeking nearness to Allah through directing to you.
All praise be to Allah Who guided me to be loyal to you,
Who conferred upon me with my visiting you,
and Who made easy for me to direct to you.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama safwati allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the chosen by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the friend of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the most beloved by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Fatimah the luminous.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا بْنَ محَمَّدٍ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Muhammad the well-chosen prophet.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْمُرْتَضَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of `Ali the well-pleased.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the luminous.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَدِيـجَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Khadijah the grand lady.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah and son of His vengeance
and the unavenged sanctity.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rates,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

lines.transliteration: wa ata`ta allaha hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: and obeyed Allah until death came upon you.
May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse the people who wronged you.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who were informed about that but they approved it.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my master! O Abu-`Abdullah!
I call Allah, His angels,
His Prophets, and His Messengers
to witness that I believe in you and in your Return
and I have faith in the laws of my religion and in the sealing deeds of mine,
and in my final return to my Lord.
Allah’s blessings be upon you all,
upon your souls, upon your bodies,
upon the present and the absent (of your group),
and upon the manifest and the hidden (of your affairs).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Seal of Prophets,
son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors,
son of the leader of the pious,

lines.arabic: وَٱبْنَ قَائِدِ ٱلْغُرِّ ٱلْمُحَجَّلِينَ إِلَىٰ جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
lines.transliteration: wabna qa'idi alghurri almuhajjalina ila jannati alnna`imi
lines.english: and son of the white-forehead, marked believers to the gardens of bliss
How can that you be anything other than this
while you are the door to the true guidance,
the guide to piety,
the firmest handle,
the argument against the inhabitants of this world,
and the fifth of the People of the Cloak.
You were nourished by the hand of mercy,
breast-fed by the bosom of faith,
and brought up in the lap of Islam.
So, my soul is definitely displeased by the way you left this world
and it has no doubt that you are alive.
Allah’s blessings be upon you,
your ascendants, and your descendants.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَرِيعَ ٱلْعَبْرَةِ ٱلسَّاكِبَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O object of the pouring tears
and match of the astounding misfortune.

lines.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
lines.transliteration: la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who violated your sanctities
and infringed the holiness of Islam.
So, you—may Allah’s blessings be upon you—were killed overwhelmed,

lines.arabic: وَأَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِكَ مَوْتُوراً
lines.transliteration: wa asbaha rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi bika mawturan
lines.english: the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household, became cut off because of loss of you,

lines.transliteration: wa asbaha kitabu allahi bifaqdika mahjuran
lines.english: and the Book of Allah became deserted due to losing you.
Peace be upon you, your grandfather, your father,
your mother, your brother,
the Imams from your descendants,
those who were martyred with you,
and the angels who are surrounding your tomb,
witnessing for your visitors,
and praying for the acceptance of the prayers of your adherents.

lines.transliteration: walssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi yabna rasuli allahi
lines.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdi allahi
lines.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you, O Abu-`Abdullah.
So unbearable is the misfortune
and so horrendous is the calamity of you

lines.arabic: عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ
lines.english: for us and for all the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

lines.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who put saddles and reins on their animals
and readied themselves for fighting against you.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my master! O Abu-`Abdullah!
I have directed to your sanctuary
and I have come to your shrine

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلشَّأْنِ ٱلَّذِي لَكَ عِنْدَهُ
lines.english: asking Almighty Allah in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
and in the name of the position that you occupy with him

lines.arabic: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani ma`akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: and to include me with your group in this world and in the Hereafter,
out of His favor, magnanimity, and generosity.

lines.transliteration: allahumma inni sallaytu wa raka`tu wa sajadtu
lines.english: O Allah, I have offered a prayer, genuflected, and prostrated myself
for Your sake purely without setting any partner with You,
since all prayers, genuflections, and prostrations
suit none except You.

lines.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: Because You are Allah; there in no god save You.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
convey to them my best greetings and compliments,
and convey to me their replies to my greetings and compliments.
O Allah, these two units of prayer

lines.arabic: هَدِيَّةٌ مِنِّي إِلَىٰ مَوْلاَيَ وَسَيِّدِي وَإِمَامِي
lines.transliteration: hadiyyatun minni ila mawlay wa sayyidi w aimami
lines.english: are present from me to my master, chief, and leader,
al-Husayn the son of `Ali, peace be upon both of them.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: وَتَقَبَّلْ ذٰلِكَ مِنِّي وَٱجْزِنِي عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa taqabbal dhalika minni wa'jurni `ala dhalika
lines.english: and accept that from me and reward me for it

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ أَمَلِي وَرَجَائِي فِيكَ وَفِي وَلِيِّكَ
lines.transliteration: afdala amali wa raja'i fika wa fi waliyyika
lines.english: in the best rewarding that I anticipate and hope from You and from Your saint.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Prophet.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of al-Husayn the martyr.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلشَّهِيدُ ٱبْنُ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O martyr and son of the martyr.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَظْلُومُ وَٱبْنُ ٱلْمَظْلُومِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O persecuted and son of the persecuted.
May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse the people who wronged you.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضَيِتْ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradayit bihi
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who were informed of that and they approved it.
Peace be upon you, O my master.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ وَلِيِّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wabna waliyyihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friend and son of His friend.
Unbearable is the misfortune
and so horrendous is the calamity of you
for us and for all faithful believers.
May Allah curse the people who slew you.

lines.arabic: وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ilayka minhum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: I release myself in the presence of Allah and you from these people in this world and in the Hereafter.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَوْلِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاءَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya awliya'a allahi wa ahibba'ahu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friends and beloved by him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَصْفِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَوِدَّاءَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya asfiya'a allahi wa awidda'ahu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O choices of Allah and His favorites.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O supporters of Allah’s Religion,
supporters of His Prophet,
supporters of the Commander of the Faithful,

lines.transliteration: wa ansara fatimata sayyidati nisa'i al`alamina
lines.english: and supporters of Fatimah the doyenne of the women of the world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O supporters of Abu-Muhammad
al-Hasan the sincere saint.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O supporters of Abu-`Abdullah
al-Husayn the wronged martyr.
Blessings of Allah be upon them all.
May my father and mother be your ransoms.

lines.arabic: طِبْتُمْ وَطَابَتِ ٱلأَرْضُ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا دُفِنْتُمْ
lines.transliteration: tibtum wa tabat al-ardu allati fiha dufintum
lines.english: Pure are you, and pure is the soil in which you were buried.
And, by Allah, great is your triumph.

lines.arabic: يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ مَعَكُمْ فَأَفُوزَ مَعَكُمْ
lines.transliteration: ya laytani kuntu ma`akum fa'afuza ma`akum
lines.english: I wish I were with you so that I would have won with you
in the gardens of Paradise with the martyrs and the righteous.
Excellent is the companionship of these.

lines.transliteration: walssalamu `alaykum wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you all.
Peace be upon you, O Abu'l-Fadl
al-`Abbas son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَوَّلِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the foremost in accepting Islam,
the leading in having faith in it,
the most perfect in carrying out the laws of Allah’s religion,
and the most careful for Islam.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَخِيكَ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu laqad nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'akhika
lines.english: I bear witness that you have acted sincerely for the sake of Allah, His Messenger, and your brother.
So, how excellent sacrificing brother you are!
May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse the people who wronged you.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who violated your sanctities
and infringed the holiness of Islam when they killed you.
Most excellent steadfast, striver brother,
defender, supporter,
one who stood up for his brother,
one who responded to the obedience to his Lord,
and one who desired for what others deemed unworthy;
namely, the abundant reward and the excellent praise you are.
May Allah attach you to the rank of your ancestors
in the Abode of Bliss.
O Allah, I am presenting myself before You
and I am intending to visit your intimate servants,
for I desire for gaining Your reward
and I hope for Your forgiveness
and abundant benevolence.

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: fa'as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: So, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa an taj`ala rizqi bihim darran
lines.english: and, (I beseech You) in their names, to make my sustenance unstoppable,
my life peaceful,
my pilgrimage admissible,
my life serene,
and my sins forgiven.
And (I beseech You to) make me return from them with success and prosperity,
having my prayers granted,
with the best things with which any one
of his visitors and comers may return;
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
